newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TABLE-Gold Fields Ghana yr net income falls.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Gold Fields Ghana yr net income falls.

text.p: Full name: Gold Fields Ghana Ltd
NOTE - The company said the current low gold price had a material adverse effect on the economically mineable underground resources and could seriously curtail the life of the old underground mine.
It said the development of the new surface mine, which represented the future of the company, was progressing well and was on track to produce its first gold early in 1998.
It said the decision had been taken to finance the project through a combination of project finance, shareholders' loans and equity.

N.M. Rothschild and Sons Ltd had been appointed as arrangers of project finance in the amount of U.S.$75 million on agreed terms, supplemented by subordinate debt if consered desirable. Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd would provide loan guarantees until completion.

The total projected capital cost of the Authorised Starter Project, which would produce 250,000 ounces of gold per annum by the year 2000, was U.S.$125 million in January 1996 money, excluding inflation and contingencies, it said.
